sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, date(lo.created_at) as d from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled'), snap as (select f.d, f.market_ticker, (select coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity) from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as qty, (select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as realized from f) select d::text as entry_date, count(*) as filled, count(*) filter (where abs(coalesce(qty,1))<=0.01) as settled, round(sum(coalesce(realized,0))::numeric,2) as realized_usd, round(min(coalesce(realized,0))::numeric,2) as worst_market from snap group by d order by d
